name: Gochujang Honey Chicken
ingredients: Scallions and sesame seeds to finish
method: Whisk gochujang, soy, honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and vinegar in the cooker.
Add thighs and turn to coat. No added liquid; the chicken releases plenty.
Cook until thighs shred easily.
Lift out and shred. Whisk the slurry into the sauce, cover on HIGH 10–15 min until glossy, then return the chicken.
finish: Scallions, sesame seeds, a squeeze of lime.
serve: Hearty: over farro or rice with quick-pickled cucumber. Lighter: over roasted broccoli and edamame. Balanced: lettuce cups with a scoop of rice.
tip: Sweet-spicy gochujang flavor with almost no hands-on time.

name: Chicken Tinga
ingredients: 1 tsp Mexican oregano, 1 tsp cumin, 2 bay leaves
method: Blend tomatoes, chipotles, adobo, garlic, oregano and cumin until smooth.
Layer sliced onion in the cooker, top with chicken, pour sauce over, tuck in bay leaves.
Cook until chicken shreds easily.
Shred in the pot, stir in vinegar, and let it sit 15 min uncovered on HIGH to tighten.
finish: Lime, cilantro, crumbled cotija or a spoon of Greek yogurt. Avocado day-of only.
serve: Hearty: corn tortillas or tostadas with black beans. Lighter: over shredded cabbage and pickled onions. Balanced: burrito bowl with half-portion rice.
tip: Heat level scales with chipotle count. Two is warm; four is properly hot.

name: Salsa Verde Chicken & White Bean Chili
method: Add everything except the Neufchâtel to the cooker.
Cook until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken in the pot. Mash about a cup of beans against the side to thicken.
Stir in the Neufchâtel until melted.
finish: Lime, cilantro, sliced jalapeño, a spoon of Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: with tortilla chips or cornbread. Lighter: as-is, extra beans optional. Balanced: as-is with a small side salad.
tip: The cream cheese is optional; skip it and stir in 1/2 cup Greek yogurt off-heat instead for +5g protein and less fat.

name: Lighter Butter Chicken
ingredients: 2.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
2 tbsp garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp cayenne
method: Optional but worth it: melt butter in a skillet, cook onion 8 min until golden, add garlic, ginger, tomato paste and spices for 1 min.
Scrape into the cooker with tomatoes and chicken; stir.
Cook until chicken is tender.
Off heat, temper the yogurt with a ladle of sauce, then stir it and the cream into the pot.
finish: Cilantro, a squeeze of lemon, kasuri methi if you have it.
serve: Hearty: basmati or naan. Lighter: over roasted cauliflower. Balanced: half rice, half cauliflower.
tip: Greek yogurt replaces most of the cream: same silkiness, roughly half the fat of a classic version.

name: Chicken Saag
ingredients: 2.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
2 tsp garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric
1 lb frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed
method: Bloom spices in oil with onion, garlic, ginger and chile (skillet, 5 min), or add straight to the cooker on busy days.
Add chicken and tomatoes. Cook until tender.
Stir in spinach for the last 30 min.
Off heat, stir in yogurt. Blitz a few pulses with an immersion blender if you like it smoother.
finish: Lemon juice and a pinch of garam masala.
serve: Hearty: basmati or roti. Lighter: as-is or with cauliflower rice. Balanced: with a small portion of rice.
tip: One of the highest protein-per-calorie curries in the set.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken & Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika
method: Toss chicken with oil, oregano, paprika, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Layer onion, garlic and chickpeas in the cooker; set chicken on top; pour broth around.
Cook until tender. Add olives in the last 30 min.
Stir in lemon juice just before serving.
finish: Feta, fresh dill or parsley, more lemon. A dollop of tzatziki is great.
serve: Hearty: with farro or warm pita. Lighter: over a big chopped cucumber-tomato salad. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Lemon juice goes in at the end; long-cooked lemon turns bitter.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 2 tsp Italian seasoning, pinch chili flakes, 2 bay leaves
method: Optional: sear seasoned thighs 3 min per side for deeper flavor.
Add vegetables to the cooker, chicken on top, then tomatoes, wine, paste and seasonings.
Cook until tender. Stir in capers for the last 15 min.
finish: Basil, parsley, grated Parmesan.
serve: Hearty: over farro, polenta or pasta. Lighter: over broccoli rabe or roasted broccoli. Balanced: over a half portion of farro.

name: Thai Red Curry Chicken & Sweet Potato
ingredients: 2.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
method: Whisk curry paste into the coconut milk with fish sauce, sugar, garlic and ginger.
Add sweet potato and onion first (they need the most heat), then chicken and pepper. Pour sauce over.
Cook until sweet potato is tender. Add broccoli for the last 30 min on HIGH.
finish: Lime juice, Thai basil or cilantro, chopped peanuts.
serve: Hearty: over jasmine rice. Lighter: as-is; the sweet potato covers carbs. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Light coconut milk keeps fat in check; full-fat adds ~90 kcal per serving.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano
method: Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken in the pot and adjust salt and lime.
finish: Lime, cilantro, crushed tortilla strips, Greek yogurt. Avocado day-of only.
serve: Hearty: a generous handful of tortilla strips or a quesadilla on the side. Lighter: as-is with extra chicken. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Freeze without toppings; tortilla strips go on fresh.

name: Chicken Pozole Verde
method: Broil tomatillos, poblanos, jalapeño and onion 8–10 min until charred (or skip for a brighter, sharper soup).
Blend charred veg with garlic, cilantro and 1 cup broth.
Add sauce, chicken, hominy, remaining broth and spices to the cooker. Cook until chicken shreds.
Shred chicken in the pot and season.
finish: Shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano, sliced jalapeño.
serve: Hearty: with tostadas. Lighter: load with cabbage and extra chicken. Balanced: as-is.
tip: The raw cabbage and radish topping is the dish; don't skip it.

name: Moroccan Chicken with Apricots & Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp ginger, 1 tsp turmeric
method: Rub chicken with spices and salt.
Add onion, carrots, garlic, chickpeas and apricots to the cooker; chicken on top; pour tomatoes and broth around.
Cook until tender.
finish: Lemon, cilantro, toasted almonds, a spoon of Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: over couscous or farro. Lighter: over cauliflower rice with greens. Balanced: half farro.

name: Filipino Chicken Adobo
ingredients: 1 tbsp whole black peppercorns, 4 bay leaves
method: Add everything to the cooker and turn the chicken to coat.
Cook until tender.
For crisp edges, broil thighs on a sheet pan 4–5 min, then return to the sauce; reduce sauce on the stove if you want it glossy.
finish: Scallions, a fried egg for extra protein.
serve: Hearty: over garlic rice. Lighter: with sautéed greens or green beans. Balanced: half rice.
tip: Five-minute prep. A pantry-only weeknight hero.

name: Chicken & Wild Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp rosemary, 2 bay leaves
method: Add everything except the milk and flour to the cooker.
Cook until rice is tender and chicken shreds.
Shred chicken. Whisk flour into milk, stir in, and cook on HIGH 20 min to thicken.
finish: Parsley, black pepper, a squeeze of lemon.
serve: Hearty: with crusty bread. Lighter: add extra chicken or a side of Greek yogurt. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Wild rice keeps its chew much better than white rice in long cooks.

name: Jerk Chicken Thighs
ingredients: Juice of 2 limes + 1/4 cup orange juice
1 tbsp allspice, 2 tsp thyme, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp nutmeg
method: Blend everything except chicken into a marinade. Marinate overnight if you can.
Add chicken and marinade to the cooker. Cook until tender.
Broil on a sheet pan 4–5 min for char, then spoon reduced sauce over.
finish: Lime wedges, scallions, quick pineapple salsa.
serve: Hearty: rice and peas (coconut rice with kidney beans). Lighter: with sautéed cabbage or slaw. Balanced: half rice and peas.

name: Chicken Shawarma Thighs
ingredients: 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp allspice
method: Mix oil, lemon, garlic and spices; coat chicken. Marinate overnight if possible.
Layer onion in the cooker, chicken on top. No added liquid.
Cook until tender. Slice or chop, then broil 3–4 min on a sheet pan for crisp edges.
finish: Garlic yogurt sauce or tahini, pickled onions, chopped parsley.
serve: Hearty: in pita or over farro with hummus. Lighter: over a chopped salad with yogurt sauce. Balanced: farro-salad bowl.
tip: The broil step turns slow-cooked chicken into something that tastes cooked on a spit.

name: Tuscan Chicken with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped
2 tsp Italian seasoning, pinch chili flakes
method: Season chicken; add to cooker with sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, broth and seasoning.
Cook until tender.
Stir in Neufchâtel and Parmesan until smooth, then fold in spinach until wilted (on HIGH, 10 min).
finish: Basil and extra Parmesan.
serve: Hearty: over pasta or farro. Lighter: over roasted broccoli. Balanced: half farro.
tip: Creamy comfort food that is still high in protein.

name: Peanut Chicken & Broccoli
method: Whisk peanut butter, soy, honey, vinegar, sriracha, garlic, ginger and broth in the cooker.
Add chicken and turn to coat. Cook until tender.
Add broccoli and pepper for the last 30–40 min on HIGH.
finish: Lime, cilantro, chopped peanuts, scallions.
serve: Hearty: over rice noodles or jasmine rice. Lighter: as-is with extra broccoli. Balanced: half rice.

name: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves, parsley stems
method: Add everything except noodles to the cooker.
Cook until chicken shreds. Shred in the pot.
Add noodles for the final 20–25 min on HIGH, or cook separately so they don't bloat in leftovers.
finish: Dill or parsley, lemon, black pepper.
serve: Hearty: add more noodles or crusty bread. Lighter: skip noodles and add extra chicken. Balanced: as written.
tip: Freeze the broth and chicken without noodles; add noodles fresh when reheating.

name: Classic Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves
method: Toss beef with flour, salt and pepper. Sear in oil in batches until deeply browned. Don't crowd the pan.
Deglaze the skillet with wine, scraping up the fond, and pour into the cooker.
Add vegetables, tomato paste, broth and seasonings; beef on top.
Cook until beef is fork-tender. Stir in peas for the last 15 min.
finish: Parsley and a splash of red wine vinegar to wake it up.
serve: Hearty: with crusty bread. Lighter: swap half the potatoes for turnips. Balanced: as written.
tip: Searing is where the stew flavor comes from. If you skip anything, skip the flour, not the sear.

name: Beef Barbacoa
ingredients: 3 lb chuck roast, trimmed, cut into 4 chunks
Juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp cider vinegar
1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp oregano, 1/2 tsp cloves, 3 bay leaves
method: Blend chipotles, adobo, onion, garlic, lime, vinegar, broth and spices.
Add beef to the cooker, pour sauce over, tuck in bay leaves.
Cook until it shreds with a fork. Shred and let it soak in the juices 20 min.
finish: Cilantro, diced onion, lime, pickled jalapeños.
serve: Hearty: tacos on corn tortillas or a burrito bowl with rice and beans. Lighter: over cabbage slaw. Balanced: bowl with half rice.

name: Korean Shredded Beef
method: Mix pear, soy, gochujang, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger.
Layer onion in the cooker, add beef, pour sauce over.
Cook until it shreds. Shred in the pot; skim fat.
finish: Scallions, sesame seeds, kimchi.
serve: Hearty: rice bowls with kimchi and a fried egg. Lighter: lettuce wraps with cucumber. Balanced: half rice, half greens.
tip: The pear is a tenderizer and the classic bulgogi sweetness, not just flavor.

name: Beef Ragù
ingredients: 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery ribs, finely diced
1 Parmesan rind, 2 bay leaves, 1 tsp oregano
method: Sear the whole roast on all sides in oil. Sweat the soffritto in the same pan 6–8 min, add paste for 1 min, deglaze with wine.
Add everything to the cooker with tomatoes, rind and herbs.
Cook until the beef falls apart. Remove rind and bay, shred the beef directly into the sauce.
finish: Parmesan, basil, a drizzle of good olive oil.
serve: Hearty: pappardelle or rigatoni. Lighter: over roasted broccoli or spaghetti squash. Balanced: over polenta, half portion.
tip: Makes a lot. Freezes perfectly in 2-serving portions.

name: Beef & Bean Chili
ingredients: 3 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tbsp cocoa
method: Brown beef hard without stirring for a crust, then break up. Add onion, pepper and garlic for 3 min.
Bloom the spices in the pan for 1 minute, then scrape everything into the cooker.
Add beans, tomatoes and broth. Cook, then adjust salt and a splash of vinegar.
finish: Greek yogurt, sharp cheddar, scallions, pickled jalapeños.
serve: Hearty: over a baked potato or with cornbread. Lighter: as-is with extra beef. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Ground meat should never go into a slow cooker raw for chili; the texture turns grainy and greasy.

name: Beef Bourguignon
ingredients: 2 cups dry red wine (Burgundy or Pinot)
method: Crisp the bacon; remove. Flour-dust the beef and sear in the fat in batches.
Deglaze with a cup of the wine; scrape into the cooker with everything else except mushrooms.
Cook. Brown the mushrooms separately and stir in for the last 30 min.
finish: Parsley. It's better on day two.
serve: Hearty: over mashed potatoes or egg noodles. Lighter: over cauliflower mash. Balanced: half potato, half cauliflower mash.
tip: Treat-tier for fat and alcohol, but the wine mostly cooks off over 8 hours.

name: Ropa Vieja
ingredients: 2.5 lb flank steak or chuck, trimmed
2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 2 bay leaves
method: Season beef with cumin, oregano, paprika, salt and pepper.
Add peppers, onion and garlic to the cooker; beef on top; pour tomatoes, paste and broth over.
Cook until it shreds. Shred, stir in olives and vinegar, rest 15 min.
finish: Cilantro. Fried sweet plantains if it's a bike day.
serve: Hearty: with rice and black beans. Lighter: over sautéed greens. Balanced: with black beans only.

name: Mongolian Beef
ingredients: 2 lb flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
method: Toss sliced beef in cornstarch (this is your velveting step and also thickens the sauce).
Whisk soy, sugar, water, garlic, ginger and sesame oil in the cooker. Add beef.
Cook on LOW only; flank toughens if overcooked. Add broccoli and scallions for the last 30 min on HIGH.
finish: Sesame seeds, chili flakes.
serve: Hearty: over jasmine rice. Lighter: extra broccoli, no rice. Balanced: half rice.
tip: Halved the usual sugar. Still sweet; flag for occasional rotation.

name: Galbi Jjim (Braised Short Ribs)
method: Optional: parboil ribs 5 min and rinse for a cleaner sauce (traditional), or sear for deeper flavor.
Mix soy, pear, sugar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Add vegetables, ribs and sauce to the cooker.
Cook until meltingly tender. Chill overnight and lift off the fat cap before reheating; this matters a lot here.
finish: Scallions, sesame seeds, jujubes or chestnuts if you have them.
serve: Hearty: over rice. Lighter: with sautéed spinach and kimchi. Balanced: half rice.
tip: Highest-fat recipe in the set even after skimming. A special-occasion braise.

name: Beef Massaman Curry
ingredients: 1 cinnamon stick, 3 cardamom pods, 2 tbsp tamarind or lime juice
method: Whisk curry paste into coconut milk with fish sauce and sugar.
Add potatoes and onion, then beef and whole spices. Pour sauce over.
Cook until beef is tender. Stir in peanuts and tamarind or lime at the end.
finish: Cilantro, more peanuts, lime.
serve: Hearty: over jasmine rice. Lighter: as-is; potatoes are already in. Balanced: as-is.

name: Italian Beef
ingredients: 1 (16-oz) jar giardiniera or pepperoncini + some brine
1 tbsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp black pepper
method: Add beef, broth, garlic, seasonings and peppers with 1/4 cup brine to the cooker.
Cook until it shreds easily; shred in the jus.
finish: Provolone if making sandwiches; more giardiniera.
serve: Hearty: on toasted hoagie rolls, dipped. Lighter: over arugula salad with peppers and shaved Parmesan. Balanced: on one open-faced roll.
tip: The beef itself is lean and high-protein; the roll is what makes it a treat.

name: Deli-Style Braised Brisket
ingredients: 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp thyme
method: Season and sear the brisket well on both sides.
Bed onions, garlic and carrots in the cooker. Set brisket fat-side up.
Whisk paste, broth, wine, sugar, vinegar and spices; pour over. Cook until tender.
Chill overnight, slice cold against the grain, skim fat, and reheat slices in the sauce.
finish: Horseradish, parsley.
serve: Hearty: with roasted potatoes or rye. Lighter: with roasted green beans. Balanced: half potatoes.
tip: Slicing cold is the trick to clean slices instead of shreds.

name: Beef & Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves
method: Sear the beef in batches.
Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until beef is tender and barley is plump. Thin with broth when reheating; barley keeps drinking.
finish: Parsley, black pepper.
serve: Hearty: with bread. Lighter: as-is. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Barley is one of the best slow-cooker grains; it holds its shape far better than rice or pasta.

name: Unstuffed Cabbage Roll Soup
ingredients: 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp brown sugar
2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp dill, 1 tsp thyme
method: Brown beef with onion and garlic.
Add everything except rice to the cooker. Cook.
Stir in rice for the last 45 min on HIGH.
finish: Dill and a spoon of Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: with rye bread. Lighter: skip the rice. Balanced: as written.
tip: All the flavor of golabki with none of the rolling.

name: Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 3 tbsp sweet Hungarian paprika + 1 tsp hot paprika
method: Cook onions in oil until deeply golden (15 min). This is the backbone of the dish.
Off heat, stir in the paprika (paprika scorches easily) and tomato paste.
Add onions, beef, peppers, garlic, broth and spices to the cooker. Cook until tender.
finish: Greek yogurt in place of sour cream, parsley.
serve: Hearty: over egg noodles or potatoes. Lighter: over cabbage sautéed with caraway. Balanced: half noodles.
tip: Onion caramelization does more for this than anything else.

name: Carnitas
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp chili powder, 2 bay leaves
method: Rub pork with spices and salt. Add to cooker with onion, garlic, bay and citrus.
Cook until it shreds.
Shred, spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with some cooking liquid, broil 5–7 min until crisp at the edges.
finish: Cilantro, onion, lime, salsa verde.
serve: Hearty: tacos or burrito bowl. Lighter: over cabbage-lime slaw. Balanced: bowl with black beans.
tip: The broil step is non-negotiable. It's the difference between pulled pork and carnitas.

name: BBQ Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp mustard powder, 1 tsp cayenne
method: Rub pork with spices and salt.
Bed onion in the cooker, add pork, vinegar and half the BBQ sauce.
Cook until it shreds. Shred, skim fat, and toss with remaining sauce.
finish: Vinegar slaw, pickles.
serve: Hearty: on buns or with cornbread. Lighter: over vinegar slaw. Balanced: on one bun, open-faced.
tip: Vinegar-forward Carolina style keeps sugar down versus sauce-drowned versions.

name: Pork Chile Verde
method: Broil tomatillos, peppers and onion until blistered; blend with garlic, cilantro and broth.
Add pork and sauce to the cooker with spices.
Cook until pork is tender. Skim fat.
finish: Lime, more cilantro, Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: with rice and warm tortillas. Lighter: with pinto beans and greens. Balanced: in a bowl with beans.

name: Kalua-Style Pork & Cabbage
ingredients: 1 tbsp Hawaiian or coarse sea salt
1/2 head green cabbage, cut into wedges
method: Pierce pork all over; rub with salt and liquid smoke.
Cook until it shreds. Add cabbage wedges for the last hour.
Shred pork into the juices with the cabbage.
finish: Green onion, a squeeze of lime.
serve: Hearty: with rice and pineapple. Lighter: as-is with extra cabbage. Balanced: half rice.
tip: Three ingredients. The easiest high-protein batch in the database.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apples & Dijon
method: Rub tenderloins with Dijon, maple, herbs, salt and pepper.
Bed apples and onion in the cooker; set pork on top; pour broth around.
Cook only to 145°F (start checking at 3 hours on LOW). Rest 10 min, then slice.
finish: Spoon apples and juices over; parsley.
serve: Hearty: with roasted sweet potato. Lighter: with roasted Brussels sprouts or green beans. Balanced: half sweet potato.
tip: Tenderloin is lean and dries out with long cooks. Use a probe thermometer; this is the one recipe here that can't be left all day.

name: Pozole Rojo
ingredients: 4 dried guajillo + 2 ancho chiles, stemmed, seeded, soaked
1 tbsp oregano, 2 tsp cumin, 2 bay leaves
method: Blend soaked chiles with garlic, half the onion and 1 cup broth until very smooth; strain.
Add pork, sauce, remaining onion, broth and spices to the cooker. Cook until tender.
Shred pork, add hominy for the last 30 min.
finish: Shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano, chile flakes.
serve: Hearty: with tostadas. Lighter: load up cabbage, extra pork. Balanced: as-is.

name: Char Siu-Style Pork
ingredients: 1 tsp five-spice, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine or dry sherry
method: Mix hoisin, soy, honey, garlic, five-spice and wine. Reserve 3 tbsp for glazing.
Coat pork and cook until tender.
Slice or shred, brush with reserved sauce, broil 3–5 min until lacquered.
finish: Scallions, sesame seeds.
serve: Hearty: rice bowls with bok choy. Lighter: with stir-fried greens and edamame. Balanced: half rice.

name: Cuban Mojo Pork
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice + juice of 3 limes
method: Mix juice, garlic, oil, cumin, oregano and salt into a mojo. Marinate pork overnight if possible.
Bed onion in the cooker; add pork and marinade.
Cook until it shreds. Shred and broil to crisp the edges.
finish: Pickled red onion, cilantro.
serve: Hearty: with black beans and rice. Lighter: with black beans and greens. Balanced: black beans only.

name: Red Beans & Rice
ingredients: 1 lb dried red kidney beans, soaked overnight
1 onion, 1 bell pepper, 3 celery ribs, diced
2 tsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves, hot sauce
method: SAFETY: boil soaked kidney beans hard for 10 minutes and drain. Slow cookers don't get hot enough to destroy the bean toxin on their own.
Brown andouille in a skillet. Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until beans are creamy. Mash some against the side to thicken.
finish: Scallions, hot sauce, a splash of vinegar.
serve: Hearty: over rice, as intended. Lighter: as-is or over greens. Balanced: half rice.
tip: Kidney beans must be boiled first. Undercooked kidney beans cause real food poisoning.

name: Split Pea Soup with Ham
ingredients: 1 lb dried green split peas, rinsed
12 oz extra-lean ham, diced (or a ham hock)
method: Add everything to the cooker; no soaking needed.
Cook until peas collapse. Stir hard or blend partially.
Thin with water when reheating; it sets firm overnight.
finish: Black pepper, a splash of vinegar, croutons.
serve: Hearty: with bread. Lighter: add extra ham. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Very high fiber and very cheap; a protein workhorse at about a dollar a serving.

name: Pork & White Bean Cassoulet
method: Sear pork and sausage; set aside.
Add soaked beans, vegetables, tomatoes, broth and herbs to the cooker; nestle meat on top.
Cook until beans are creamy. Optional: top with toasted breadcrumbs and parsley before serving.
finish: Toasted garlic breadcrumbs, parsley.
serve: Hearty: with crusty bread. Lighter: with a bitter greens salad. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Chicken sausage stands in for duck confit and pork sausage: same spirit, a fraction of the fat.

name: Pork Vindaloo
ingredients: 6 dried Kashmiri chiles, soaked (or 2 tbsp Kashmiri chili powder)
2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp mustard seed, 1 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp cloves
method: Blend chiles, vinegar, garlic, ginger and spices to a paste. Marinate pork overnight.
Brown onions in oil until deep golden; add with pork, marinade and paste to the cooker.
Cook until tender. Season with salt and a little brown sugar if too sharp.
finish: Cilantro, sliced onion.
serve: Hearty: basmati rice. Lighter: with sautéed cabbage. Balanced: half rice.

name: Turkey & Sweet Potato Chili
ingredients: 3 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cinnamon
method: Brown turkey hard, undisturbed, for a crust. Add onion, pepper, garlic and spices for 2 min.
Scrape into the cooker with everything else.
Cook until sweet potato is tender.
finish: Lime, cilantro, Greek yogurt, pickled red onion.
serve: Hearty: as-is with tortilla chips. Lighter: as-is; it's balanced on its own. Balanced: as-is.

name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara
ingredients: 1/4 cup parsley, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp fennel seed
method: Mix turkey, eggs, Parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, herbs and salt. Roll into 24 balls.
Pour half the sauce into the cooker, add meatballs in a single layer if possible, cover with remaining sauce.
Cook without stirring for the first 2 hours so they set.
finish: Basil, extra Parmesan, a little fresh mozzarella.
serve: Hearty: over spaghetti or in sub rolls. Lighter: over roasted broccoli. Balanced: over a half portion of pasta.
tip: Optional: broil the meatballs 5 min before adding for better texture.

name: Turkey & Lentil Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 (14.5-oz) can diced tomatoes with green chiles
2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano
method: Brown turkey with onion and garlic.
Add to cooker with lentils, tomatoes, broth and spices.
Cook until lentils are tender and liquid is mostly absorbed. Cook uncovered 20 min on HIGH if loose.
finish: Lime, cilantro, salsa, shredded lettuce, cheddar.
serve: Hearty: tacos or a burrito bowl. Lighter: taco salad. Balanced: two tacos plus salad.
tip: Lentils stretch the meat, double the fiber, and disappear into the texture.

name: Herb Turkey Breast with Pan Gravy
method: Rub turkey with butter, herbs, salt and pepper.
Set on top of vegetables in the cooker; add broth.
Cook to 160°F, then rest 15 min. Strain liquid into a pan, whisk in cornstarch slurry, simmer to gravy.
finish: Cranberry sauce, parsley.
serve: Hearty: with mashed potatoes or stuffing. Lighter: with green beans and roasted broccoli. Balanced: half sweet potato.
tip: The leanest protein in the database. Slice and portion for a week of lunches.

name: Turkey Keema with Peas
ingredients: 1 tbsp garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric
method: Brown turkey and onions until golden; add garlic, ginger, chile and spices for 1 min.
Add to cooker with tomatoes. Cook.
Stir in peas for the last 20 min, and yogurt off heat.
finish: Cilantro, lemon.
serve: Hearty: with basmati or naan. Lighter: in lettuce cups or over cauliflower. Balanced: half rice.

name: Turkey Bolognese
ingredients: 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery ribs, finely diced
1 Parmesan rind, 1 tsp oregano, pinch nutmeg
method: Brown turkey hard; add soffritto and cook 6 min, then paste 1 min. Deglaze with wine.
Add to cooker with tomatoes, milk, rind and seasonings.
Cook. Remove rind; season.
finish: Parmesan, basil.
serve: Hearty: over tagliatelle or rigatoni. Lighter: over roasted broccoli or spaghetti squash. Balanced: half pasta, half veg.
tip: Milk is traditional; it softens the acidity and tenderizes the meat.

name: Unstuffed Pepper Soup with Farro
ingredients: 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp smoked paprika
method: Brown turkey with onion and garlic.
Add everything except farro to the cooker. Cook.
Stir in farro for the last 60–75 min on HIGH.
finish: Parmesan or a little shredded mozzarella, parsley.
serve: Hearty: add extra farro. Lighter: halve the farro. Balanced: as written.
tip: All the flavor of stuffed peppers, without the stuffing and baking.

name: Lamb Tagine with Chickpeas
ingredients: Ras el hanout 2 tbsp (or cumin, coriander, cinnamon, ginger), pinch saffron
method: Toss lamb with spices and salt; sear in batches.
Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until lamb is tender. Skim fat before serving.
finish: Cilantro, toasted almonds, preserved lemon or lemon zest.
serve: Hearty: over couscous or farro. Lighter: with roasted cauliflower. Balanced: half farro.

name: Lamb Rogan Josh
ingredients: 2 tbsp Kashmiri chili, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp fennel, 4 cardamom pods, 1 cinnamon stick
method: Brown onions deeply in oil; add garlic, ginger, paste and spices for 1 min.
Sear lamb. Add everything except the yogurt to the cooker with 1/2 cup water.
Cook until tender. Temper yogurt and stir in off heat.
finish: Cilantro.
serve: Hearty: basmati or naan. Lighter: with sautéed spinach. Balanced: half rice.

name: Greek Lamb with Lemon Potatoes
ingredients: 2.5 lb lamb shoulder, trimmed, large chunks
Zest + juice of 2 lemons, 1 tbsp oregano, rosemary
method: Rub lamb with garlic, oregano, rosemary, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Bed potatoes and onion in the cooker; lamb on top; add broth and wine.
Cook until lamb falls apart. Add lemon juice at the end; finish with feta.
finish: Feta, parsley, lemon, tzatziki.
serve: Hearty: as-is with pita. Lighter: swap half the potatoes for green beans. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Kleftiko-style without the parchment parcel.

name: Cioppino
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp oregano, pinch chili flakes, 2 bay leaves
method: Add everything except seafood to the cooker. Cook the base.
Turn to HIGH. Add fish for 20 min, then shrimp for the final 10 min, until just opaque.
Seafood should never go in at the start; it goes rubbery.
finish: Parsley, lemon, chili flakes.
serve: Hearty: with sourdough for dunking. Lighter: as-is. Balanced: as-is with one slice bread.
tip: Freeze only the tomato-fennel base; seafood should be cooked fresh.

name: Shrimp & Chicken Sausage Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
1 onion, 1 bell pepper, 3 celery ribs, diced
1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves
method: Add everything except shrimp to the cooker. Cook.
Add shrimp for the last 15 min on HIGH.
Cook rice separately and fold in, or serve over it. Rice cooked in a slow cooker turns to paste.
finish: Scallions, parsley, hot sauce.
serve: Hearty: folded into 1 cup cooked rice per serving. Lighter: over cauliflower rice. Balanced: over 1/2 cup rice.
tip: Macros shown are for the stew without rice.

name: Coconut Fish Curry
ingredients: 2 lb cod or other firm white fish, 2-inch chunks
1 tsp mustard seed, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp Kashmiri chili, 1 tsp coriander, curry leaves
1 tbsp tamarind paste or lime juice
method: Add everything except fish and tamarind to the cooker; cook the base.
Turn to HIGH, slide in fish, cook 20–30 min until it flakes.
Stir in tamarind or lime gently.
finish: Cilantro, lime.
serve: Hearty: with rice or appam. Lighter: with sautéed greens. Balanced: half rice.
tip: Leanest curry in the set.

name: Cuban Black Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans, soaked overnight
2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, 2 bay leaves
2 tbsp sherry or red wine vinegar
method: Add everything except vinegar to the cooker.
Cook until beans are very tender.
Blend about half, stir in vinegar, and season.
finish: Greek yogurt, red onion, cilantro, hard-boiled egg (traditional and +6g protein).
serve: Hearty: over rice. Lighter: top with 2 chopped eggs and a side of chicken. Balanced: as-is with yogurt.
tip: On its own this is a carb-forward pot; pair with eggs or yogurt to hit protein.

name: Red Lentil Dal
ingredients: 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander
Tadka: 1 tbsp ghee or oil, 1 tsp cumin seed, 1 tsp mustard seed, 2 dried chiles
method: Add lentils, onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, water and ground spices.
Cook until lentils collapse. Stir in spinach.
Fry the tadka in a small pan until seeds pop and pour sizzling over the dal.
finish: Lemon, cilantro, Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: with basmati or roti. Lighter: with a side of chicken or 2 eggs. Balanced: with yogurt.
tip: The tadka at the end is what makes it taste restaurant-grade.

name: Chana Masala
ingredients: 2 tbsp chana masala or garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp amchur
method: Brown onions in oil (worth it); add garlic, ginger, chile and spices for 1 min.
Add to cooker with chickpeas, tomatoes and water.
Cook until chickpeas are creamy. Mash a few to thicken.
finish: Lemon, cilantro, sliced onion, Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: with rice or naan. Lighter: with grilled chicken or paneer. Balanced: with yogurt.

name: Tuscan White Bean & Kale Soup
ingredients: 1 Parmesan rind, rosemary, thyme, 2 bay leaves
method: Add beans, vegetables, tomatoes, broth, rind and herbs.
Cook until beans are creamy. Add kale for the last 30 min.
Remove rind. Stir in Parmesan and a good drizzle of olive oil.
finish: Parmesan, olive oil, chili flakes, lemon.
serve: Hearty: with crusty bread. Lighter: add sliced chicken sausage. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Add 12 oz chicken sausage to push it from 'side' into 'main' protein territory.

name: Three-Bean Vegetarian Chili
ingredients: 3 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cocoa
method: Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until lentils are tender and chili is thick.
finish: Greek yogurt, cheddar, scallions, avocado day-of.
serve: Hearty: with cornbread. Lighter: top with Greek yogurt and a fried egg. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Lentils give it a meaty body without any meat.

name: Lentil Bolognese
ingredients: 1.5 cups dried brown or green lentils
1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery ribs, finely diced
1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp basil
method: Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until lentils are tender and sauce is thick.
finish: Parmesan, basil.
serve: Hearty: over pasta. Lighter: stir in cottage cheese or top with Parmesan and serve over broccoli. Balanced: half pasta.

name: Smoky Black-Eyed Peas & Collards
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas, rinsed (no soak needed)
8 oz turkey bacon or smoked turkey, chopped
1 bunch collard greens, stems removed, sliced
1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, 2 bay leaves
method: Add everything except vinegar to the cooker.
Cook until peas are tender.
Stir in vinegar and hot sauce to taste.
finish: Hot sauce, chopped onion.
serve: Hearty: over rice (Hoppin' John) or with cornbread. Lighter: as-is. Balanced: as-is.

name: Gochujang Tofu & Chickpea Stew
method: Add everything except tofu to the cooker. Cook.
Add tofu for the last 45 min so it stays intact.
finish: Scallions, a soft egg, sesame seeds.
serve: Hearty: with rice. Lighter: as-is with a soft-boiled egg. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Plant-based and still a genuine protein main.

name: White Bean Minestrone
method: Add everything except pasta, spinach and Parmesan. Cook.
Stir in pasta for the last 25 min on HIGH and spinach at the end.
Stir in Parmesan to serve.
finish: Pesto swirl, Parmesan, olive oil.
serve: Hearty: as written with bread. Lighter: skip pasta, add 1 lb chicken sausage. Balanced: as written.
tip: On its own this is a lighter, lower-protein pot; treat as a side or add a protein.

name: Sweet Potato, Chickpea & Spinach Curry
ingredients: 2 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric
method: Add everything except spinach.
Cook until sweet potatoes are tender. Stir in spinach.
finish: Lime, cilantro, Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: with rice. Lighter: pair with chicken or top with a fried egg. Balanced: with yogurt.
tip: Hearty and filling; the sweet potatoes make it a meal on their own.

name: Charro Beans
ingredients: 8 oz turkey kielbasa or chicken sausage, sliced
method: Crisp bacon; add sausage and onion for 3 min.
Add to the cooker with beans, jalapeños, garlic, tomatoes, broth and spices.
Cook until beans are creamy.
finish: Cilantro, lime.
serve: Hearty: with tortillas and rice. Lighter: alongside carnitas or barbacoa. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Works as a side to any of the pulled meats or as a light main.

name: Mushroom & Barley Stew
ingredients: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp dill, 2 bay leaves
method: Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until barley and lentils are tender. Thin with broth as needed.
finish: Dill, Greek yogurt, black pepper.
serve: Hearty: as-is. Lighter: add shredded chicken. Balanced: as-is with yogurt.
tip: Lentils added to the classic to make it a real meal.

name: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
ingredients: 1 lb dried kidney beans, soaked overnight
2 tsp garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp Kashmiri chili
method: SAFETY: boil soaked kidney beans hard for 10 minutes and drain before they go in the cooker.
Brown onions in oil; add garlic, ginger and spices for 1 min.
Add everything to the cooker. Cook until beans are creamy; mash a few to thicken.
finish: Cilantro, lemon, Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: rajma chawal, over rice as intended. Lighter: with chicken or paneer. Balanced: with yogurt.
tip: Kidney beans must be boiled first. See the safety note.

name: West African Peanut Stew
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp cinnamon
method: Whisk peanut butter into the broth.
Add everything except greens to the cooker. Cook.
Stir in greens for the last 30 min.
finish: Chopped peanuts, cilantro, lime.
serve: Hearty: over rice or with flatbread. Lighter: add shredded chicken thighs (classic maafe uses chicken). Balanced: as-is.
tip: Add 2 lb chicken thighs to the pot for a maafe that clears 35g protein.

name: Overnight Protein Steel-Cut Oats
ingredients: 1 tsp cinnamon, pinch salt, 1 tsp vanilla
To serve: 1/2 cup Greek yogurt per bowl
method: Grease the cooker well. Add oats, water, milk, apple, cinnamon and salt.
Cook overnight on LOW.
Stir in maple. Top each bowl with Greek yogurt (that's where most of the protein comes from).
finish: Walnuts, berries, extra cinnamon.
serve: Hearty: as-is with banana. Lighter: add a scoop of protein powder or side of eggs. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Macros include 1/2 cup Greek yogurt per serving.

name: Spinach-Feta Egg Bake
method: Line the cooker with parchment (makes lifting out easy) and grease it.
Whisk eggs, whites and cottage cheese; fold in everything else.
Cook until center is set. Lay a paper towel under the lid to catch condensation.
finish: Hot sauce, herbs.
serve: Hearty: with toast or roasted potatoes. Lighter: as-is. Balanced: as-is with fruit.
tip: Slice into 6 squares; freezes and reheats well for grab-and-go breakfasts.

name: Mexican Breakfast Casserole
method: Brown chorizo with pepper and onion; drain fat.
Line and grease the cooker. Whisk eggs and whites; fold in everything.
Cook until set, paper towel under the lid.
finish: Salsa, cilantro, Greek yogurt.
serve: Hearty: in warm tortillas. Lighter: as-is. Balanced: as-is.
tip: Chorizo as flavor, not the main protein: a little goes a long way.
